subject: [PATCH 24/60] mm/madvise: restrict reclaim advice to common memory

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series aims to restrict the reclaim advice of MADV_COLD, MADV_PAGEOUT, and MADV_FREE operations to common memory only. The current implementation checks for ZONE_DEVICE folios, which is being replaced by a new check using folio_is_common_memory(). This change ensures that these operations are limited to common memory, preventing potential issues with device-specific memory.
